patthana17.30:1.1: upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana17.30:3.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ anupādinna anupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na anupādinna anupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha. anidassana appaṭighaṃ saṃkiliṭṭha saṃkilesikaṃ
